header.name: Several Complex Variables
header.description: The theory of Several complex variables (SCV) lies at the intersection of several other fields in mathematics. There are deep connections to Algebraic Geometry (both real and complex), Functional Analysis, Geometry, Partial Differential Equations, complex Dynamics, Potential Theory, and of course One Variable Complex Analysis. Additionally, the theory of SCV and it’s techniques have been used in understanding deep results in Number Theory, Representation Theory and Commutative Algebra. Apart from various fields of mathematics, SCV has it’s application in Quantum Field Theory as well as other branches in mathematical physics. Since it is hard to accommodate all of the aforementioned aspects of SCV in one course, we plan to understand some of the basic aspects of holomorphic functions in SCV along with one of  it’s connection to Algebraic geometry over complex numbers and Functional Analysis. Thus, the learning outcomes from this course will facilitate further understanding of various topics in SCV, Functional Analysis, Number Theory related topics.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to define the notion of a holomorphic function in SCV. They will be able to compute complex derivative of functions in SCV.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to describe various properties of holomorphic functions in SCV. Important examples of Hilbert spaces of holomorphic functions will be explained.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will  develop knowledge on complex analytic varieties. They will be able to correlate certain key mathematical theorems and concepts in their respective disciplines.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to construct meromorphic functions in SCV, divisors and line bundles.

lecture_topics: Review of complex analysis in dimension 1.
Complex derivatives and their properties in SCV.
Definitions and basic properties of holomorphic functions of several variables: Cauchy’s integral formula, power series
Analytic continuation: Hertog’s phenomena and consequences.
Violation of Riemann mapping theorem in SCV: Inequivalence of Ball and Poly-disc
An alternative way of proving the inequivalence of Ball and Poly-disc: Hilbert spaces of holomorphic functions.
Ring of germs of holomorphic functions.
Ring of germs and it’s properties
Complex analytic varieties, examples and their basic properties.
